title: Agent dashboard selection is keyboard accessible

assertions.evidence: Web and Landing use a native button with the accessible name Select agent <name>; selection state is exposed through aria-pressed and the visible label changes to Selected.
The button has a 44px minimum block size (Tailwind min-h-11 at the project's 16px root size) and a visible focus-visible ring; card selection no longer depends on clicking a non-focusable div.

The scoped source contract test passed 2/2 across Web and Landing. Web/Landing production build, TypeScript and ESLint passed; Web diagnostics passed 19/19; API/Cloud regressions passed 43/43 and 20/20; Browser build/lint and focused tests passed 16/16.
Connected in-app browser performed a harmless navigation to the locally built candidate at http://127.0.0.1:4173/ and confirmed the KELEDON page/version 5.1.85.

limitations: The local page navigation verified browser access and the production build, but the authenticated agent dashboard was not rendered because no safe synthetic socket fixture is available in this checkout; browser interaction with a populated agent card is not claimed.
Screen-reader certification, broad role/route accessibility, mobile layout across the full dashboard, and native Browser/Electron acceptance remain open.
